content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Is there a way to send e-mails from [product_name]? I'm using [product_name] to control a cooling system, and when a safety event occurs, I want to receive a report (such as IO status or flags) via e-mail. Thank you for your response.
With [product_name] communication module CMR [article_no], you can send SMS. [url] [url] [url]

Hi, I purchased a [article_no] last autumn and assumed it could send e-mails. I hope [company_name] realizes that SMS is outdated. I tried confirming this via Swedish phone support, but no one seems concerned. My support contact spoke to the [product_name] product manager, who mentioned few requests for this feature and believes other [company_name] products offer it. If you agree, please ask for this function so it can be implemented.
I also bought a [article_no] thinking it could send warning emails, but apparently that isn't possible. It looks like I'll be returning my [product_name] to the store.

Since you've posted here, I assume you're seeking help. To provide support, we need to know exactly what you're trying to achieve. A [product_name] cannot send e-mails or SMS directly; accessories are required for that.
Hello, I have a similar issue. Are there any modules available that allow sending e-mail notifications over Ethernet (without relying on a GSM modem)? Thanks for your answer.
Maybe this link will be helpful: [url]

Just so you know, with the latest firmware, e-mails can be sent from the CMR [article_no], but currently it only works via mobile connection, not LAN. (You need airtime and a mobile signal.) Another option is using Node Red on IoT devices like Raspberry Pi, Arduino, BeagleBone, or similar Linux devices. You can even interact with social media platforms like Twitter. [url] The video is long but very informative.
Hi, I also recommend using [company_name] IoT devices with Node Red installed to send e-mails, and possibly SMS via an SMS gateway or online SMS service. Check this link: [url] Cheers.
With Node Red, you can even send tweets or respond to Twitter feeds. [url] I managed to do it myself!

Hello, With new software, you can send an e-mail using Excel, [product_name] Access Tool, and a computer. Set a trigger using the Worksheet_Calculate() function, then call a function in Excel VBA to send the e-mail (e.g., Call SendEmail()). The Access Tool enables communication between [product_name] and Excel. [url]

analysis.insight_summary: Users want the [product_name] hardware to provide easy e-mail notification features for alerts and monitoring in automation settings. The absence of native e-mail support in the [product_name] Basis Module led to disappointment and unmet user needs. Most solutions suggest using additional modules or third-party tools, with some progress through newer communication accessories. There is a clear preference for e-mail and modern messaging solutions over SMS, revealing a disconnect between user expectations and current product capabilities.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to directly send e-mails when trigger events occur, allowing fast and remote notifications or status updates without needing extra modules or external hardware.
